Student Recruitment and Excellence Scholarship
Qatar University offers this scholarship to newly admitted, academically outstanding students residing in the State of Qatar. The scholarship is divided into two main tracks:
Recruitment Track:
Designated for students wishing to enroll in specific colleges and majors, including:
College of Arts and Sciences (scientific majors)
College of Education (scientific and exact disciplines)
College of Nursing
College of Sharia and Islamic Studies
Excellence Track:
Intended for academically outstanding students across all colleges of the University, including those covered under the Attraction Track. Awards are granted based on seat availability, and applicants are selected on a competitive basis.
Program Objective
To attract academically distinguished students to Qatar University.

Exemption from textbook fees

to Qatar University.
Applicant should not get benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.
Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:
To maintain the scholarship, the student must comply with the following conditions:
The scholarship shall be effective from the semester of award. If the student does not pass his/her first semester, the scholarship will be terminated and the student will be informed by QU email.
The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.

H.H. the Emir of Qatar's Scholarship for Academic Excellence
Qatar University offers this scholarship to students of outstanding performance in the Qatari Secondary Education Certificate who wish to join an undergraduate major at Qatar University.
Scholarship Objective
Recruiting students of outstanding Qatari Secondary Education Certificate performance.
Scholarship Details
The student must apply for the Admission Scholarship only, and the top achievers are selected for this scholarship on a competitive basis.
Scholarship Program
Targeted Category
Benefits
H.H. the Emir of Qatar's Scholarship for Academic Excellence
Students of outstanding performance in the Qatari Secondary Education Certificate for Bachelor degree
Exemption from tuition fees
Exemption from textbook fees
Monthly salary of 1,000 QR for 9 months per academic year
Requirements for application:
The applicant must hold a Qatari Secondary Education Certificate.
A minimum average of 95% in the secondary school certificate.
The applicant should be a secondary school graduate in the same year in which the scholarship application is made.
These scholarship awards are only made in the Fall semester.

GCC States Scholarships (Embassies)
Qatar University offers this scholarship to academically distinguished students of Gulf Cooperation Council states (GCC) who hold the High School Certificate or its equivalent from their countries or any other country but not from Qatar and are seeking to join an undergraduate program at Qatar University. The student must submit their application for admission to the undergraduate program at Qatar University in person. A number of scholarships are allocated to each GCC state and nominating candidates to these scholarships is left to GCC embassies. Such scholarships can be postponed to the second term in the same academic year but not to the next academic year.
Scholarship Objective
Attracting distinguished students from the GCC states to Qatar University.
Scholarship Details

Exemption from tuition fees.

Obtain a letter from the embassy addressed to Qatar University requesting consideration for this specific scholarship.
Applicant cannot benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.

Talent Scholarship
Talent Scholarship Requirements and how to apply
Qatar University offers this scholarship to undergraduate non-Qatari students (including international students) who are talented in the fields of scientific research, technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and
athleticism
. Applicants for this scholarship are selected on a competitive basis.
Scholarship Objective
Recruiting talented students in the fields of scientific research, technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and
athleticism
.
Scholarship Details
Scholarship Program
Targeted Category
Benefits
Talent Scholarship
Talented students for Bachelor degree
Exemption from tuition fees
Exemption from textbook fees
Monthly salary of 1,000 QR
Guarantee to be admitted to the desired program of study upon meeting the minimum program admission requirements (except for medicine and dental medicine)
For international talented students:
Student housing (two students per room) including transportation to/from campus, annual round trip air fare ticket and residence permit under QU sponsorship.
Requirements for application:
The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
A minimum high school average of 80%.
Applicant must meet the minimum admissions requirements of the program that he/she wishes to join.
Applicant must submit the final transcript of the 11th grade with a minimum average of 80%.
Applicant must submit the final transcript of the first semester of the 12th grade with a minimum average of 80%.
Applicant must provide a minimum of two letters of recommendation to support the application from prestigious entities relevant to the area of talent.

How to Apply
The applicant may apply to the talent scholarship through the
online admission application
on “Scholarship Application” page during the announced application period. The applicant is requested to upload the required and supporting documents presenting his/her talent and achievements.
Application and evaluation procedures:
Students apply for admission and for scholarship online using the
online admission application
during the announced application period.
Students enrolled in schools outside Qatar or in private schools inside Qatar (non-governmental Qatari school system) must upload the first semester certificate of grade twelve and the final certificate of grade eleven. If the student completed grade twelve, he/she must submit only the final certificate of grade twelve.
Applicant must upload a minimum of two recommendation letters through the
online admission application
from recognized entities relevant to the area of talent to support the application.
Applicant must submit a letter summarizing his/her talent, achievements, and awards received with a link to large-size files including videos and any other supporting documents (e.g. on Dropbox or OneDrive) to highlight his/her talent and to show the recent achievements in one field of the following talents: scientific research (includes all art and scientific fields), technology, innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and sports.
The applicants' files will be evaluated and interviews will be conducted to assess the eligibility and qualifications of the applicant. The best applicants for each talent field will be short-listed.
An initial conditional acceptance letter will be sent to the nominated students, within six weeks after the deadline of the online scholarship application, stating the conditions that must be met and the documents required to receive the final acceptance.
For international students, after they send the required documents, the university will apply for their visas and they will be notified accordingly.
The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to students by email according to the announced
timeline
.

Other types of scholarships
Short Scholarships for the Arabic Program for Non-Native Program
This scholarship is designed to learn Arabic for non-native speakers students from outside Qatar. The admission process to this scholarship is handling by the Scholarships and International Admissions Section in coordinating with the Arabic for Non-Native Speakers Program. The student can be nominated by one of the organizations which have an established agreement with Qatar University and admitted by the President of Qatar University to grant scholarship on annual basis. The program duration is one academic year.
In order to know how to apply to this scholarship please visit the following page:
Arabic for Non-native Speakers Program
.
College of Education Diploma Scholarships
Qatar University offers a number of scholarships for students who want to join the diploma programs offered by the
College of Education
.
Benefits
These scholarships include exemption from tuition fees only.
Requirements for application
:
The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.
The applicant must be working under the ministry of education and higher education or any governmental educational organization.
It should be the first time for the applicant to apply for a scholarship in the same category offered by the College of Education.
Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:
The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 out of 4 at the end of each semester.
The duration of studying shouldn't exceed two semesters excluding the semesters of absence and withdrawal.
The student should not be absent or withdraw for two separated or consecutive semesters.
